items.headline: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will stay shut until demands are met
items.summary: Iran denied holding talks with the US. Parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf told Al Jazeera the strait will 'never return' to how it was before the war.

items.headline: Israeli strike hits Gaza hospital as UN appeals for tents
items.summary: At least 13 Palestinians were killed across Gaza, including at least six in a strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, according to Gaza's health ministry. The UN made an emergency appeal for waterproof tents for flooded families.

items.headline: Storm Charles grounds over 300 flights in Portugal
items.summary: Portugal cancelled more than 300 flights and shut schools as Storm Charles brought flooding to Lisbon.

items.headline: FTSE 100 rises 0.8% as energy and miners recover
items.summary: London's top index gained 83.88 points to 10,835.47 on Wednesday. BP rose 2.7% as oil and copper prices climbed, and strong results from AI cloud firm CoreWeave lifted tech shares.
items.source: Share Talk and Ad Hoc News (citing Reuters), 11 Nov

items.headline: SoftBank swings to a $7bn quarterly loss
items.summary: The loss includes a $3.7bn write-down on US data-centre power equipment after plans changed. SoftBank still raised a record $56.5bn in the quarter.

items.headline: OpenAI revenue jumps to $10bn a quarter, with big losses
items.summary: OpenAI's third-quarter revenue rose 50% to $10bn, but it made an adjusted operating loss of $10.9bn, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.headline: Anthropic starts IPO roadshow at up to $1.4tn
items.summary: Anthropic is offering shares at $70-78 each, which could value it at up to $1.4 trillion. Google and Nvidia are each putting in about $10bn alongside the listing.
items.source: AI Frontier Daily and Market News (citing TechCrunch), 11 Nov

items.headline: Nvidia board investigates its chief executive
items.summary: Nvidia's board hired outside lawyers to investigate Jensen Huang, as the FBI and three House committees opened their own inquiries. The shares fell about 5% on Wednesday.
items.source: AI Frontier Daily and BitDigest, 11 Nov

items.headline: US and China open talks on advanced AI risks
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two countries have started a dialogue on the risks of superintelligent AI. They also plan a direct channel for alerting each other to AI incidents.
items.source: BitDigest (citing CNBC) and The Neuron, 11 Nov
